title: VASP Tracker: Crypto licensing deadlines worldwide and Brazil SPSAV tracker
description: Open data on when crypto firms (virtual-asset service providers) must be licensed in 78 jurisdictions, with every date linked to the law, official gazette or regulator notice, plus a company-level tracker of 170 platforms serving Brazil and their status in Banco Central do Brasil authorisation data (SPSAV). Snapshot of 23 Nov 2026 (version 1.5.0); BCB reference date 31/10/2026. Live, continuously refreshed version: https://vasptracker.com/
